conclusion.attribution: For a bounded local cylinder g, a disagreement from an outside root can influence g only through a connected overlap word. The finite jump-history expansion gives a factor t^(ell-1)/(ell-1)! for a word of length ell, and integrating over [0,T] gives T^ell/ell!.
conclusion.bound: Minkowski and the R-515 square-transport identity bound every word coefficient in L2(nu_n) by one. Reverse-word counting gives at most a_w*b^(ell-1) words, while the two-copy rate-difference triangle contributes 2^ell. Thus integral_0^T ||A_n^(out,m)Q_n(t)g||_2 dt <= 4||g||_infinity E_d(a_w,2b,T) whenever 2bT<d+1.
conclusion.constants: The exact source-derived connectivity constant is b=144 and the explicit coupling envelope uses b_eff=2b=288; for a two-column support a_w=112.
conclusion.distance: Because overlapping radius-2 footprints have base-column displacement at most 4, the graph distance from a fixed support to roots leaving Lambda_m grows at least as max(1,ceil((m-w-4)/4)).
